text_en: Now Gorgias took five thousand infantry and one thousand picked cavalry, and this division moved out by night
text_cn: 哥尔基雅率领五千步兵，一千精骑，乘夜进军，

text_en: to fall upon the camp of the Jews and attack them suddenly. Men from the citadel were his guides.
text_cn: 偷袭犹太人营幕，乘虚突击；堡垒里的人给他作向导。

text_en: But Judas heard of it, and he and his warriors moved out to attack the king’s force in Emmaus
text_cn: 犹大一听这消息，便与军队起程，去突击驻扎厄玛乌王军；

text_en: while the division was still absent from the camp.
text_cn: 这时王军还散在营外。

text_en: When Gorgias entered the camp of Judas by night, he found no one there, so he looked for them in the hills, because he said, “These men are running away from us. ”
text_cn: 哥尔基雅夜间来到犹大营里，不见一人，遂在山中搜寻说：“这些人避开我们逃走了。”

text_en: At daybreak Judas appeared in the plain with three thousand men, but they did not have armor and swords such as they desired.
text_cn: 天已亮时，犹大领着三千士兵，出现在平原之上，但没有佩带所需要的甲胄（zhòu）和刀剑。

text_en: And they saw the camp of the Gentiles, strong and fortified, with cavalry all around it; and these men were trained in war.
text_cn: 他们看见异民的军营防守坚固，又有马队巡逻，还都是受过军训的士兵。

text_en: But Judas said to those who were with him, “Do not fear their numbers or be afraid when they charge.
text_cn: 犹大便对同人说：“你们不必害怕他们人数众多，也不要畏惧他们的攻击。

text_en: Remember how our ancestors were saved at the Red Sea, when Pharaoh with his forces pursued them.
text_cn: 你们要回忆，当我们的祖先被法郎的军队追赶的时候，他们怎样在红海里获救。

text_en: And now, let us cry to Heaven, to see whether he will favor us and remember his covenant with our ancestors and crush this army before us today.
text_cn: 现在我们要呼吁上天，希望他怜悯我们，记忆他与我们祖先立的盟约，今天在我们前粉碎这支军队，

text_en: Then all the Gentiles will know that there is one who redeems and saves Israel. ”
text_cn: 使万民知道，有一位解救以色列的。”

text_en: When the foreigners looked up and saw them coming against them,
text_cn: 外方人举目一望，见犹太人从对面来了，

text_en: they went out from their camp to battle. Then the men with Judas blew their trumpets
text_cn: 便出营作战；犹大的同志们于是吹起号角。

text_en: and engaged in battle. The Gentiles were crushed, and fled into the plain,
text_cn: 双方交锋，异民不支溃败，向平原逃去。

text_en: and all those in the rear fell by the sword. They pursued them to Gazara, and to the plains of Idumea, and to Azotus and Jamnia; and three thousand of them fell.
text_cn: 落后的敌军，全丧身刀下。犹太人追击他们，直到革则尔，直到依杜默雅、阿左托及雅木尼雅平原。敌方阵亡的约三千人。

text_en: Then Judas and his force turned back from pursuing them,
text_cn: 犹大和他的军队追赶敌人回来，

text_en: and he said to the people, “Do not be greedy for plunder, for there is a battle before us;
text_cn: 对军队说：“你们不要贪恋战利品，因为前面还有战争：

text_en: Gorgias and his force are near us in the hills. But stand now against our enemies and fight them, and afterward seize the plunder boldly. ”
text_cn: 哥尔基雅和他的军队还在山中，离我们不远。现今要在敌人前坚定不移，与他们作战，然后才可安心拾取战利品。”

text_en: Just as Judas was finishing this speech, a detachment appeared, coming out of the hills.
text_cn: 犹大还在说话时，发现有一部分敌人从山上窥望，

text_en: They saw that their army had been put to flight, and that the Jews were burning the camp, for the smoke that was seen showed what had happened.
text_cn: 这些人一见自己的军队已败退，兵营亦被焚烧，又见烟柱四起，即知发生了事故。

text_en: When they perceived this, they were greatly frightened, and when they also saw the army of Judas drawn up in the plain for battle,
text_cn: 他们一见如此，非常震惊；又见犹大的军队在平原摆好作战的阵势，

text_en: they all fled into the land of the Philistines.
text_cn: 于是全都逃往培肋舍特人的地方去了。

text_en: Then Judas returned to plunder the camp, and they seized a great amount of gold and silver, and cloth dyed blue and sea purple, and great riches.
text_cn: 犹大回来拾取军营的战利品，得了很多金银、紫红和珍贵的朱红色衣服，还有大量的财物。

text_en: On their return they sang hymns and praises to Heaven—“For he is good, for his mercy endures forever. ”
text_cn: 他们回来的时候，唱歌赞美上天，“因为他是美善的，他的仁慈永远常存。”

text_en: Thus Israel had a great deliverance that day.
text_cn: 这一天以色列得了大胜利。

text_en: Those of the foreigners who escaped went and reported to Lysias all that had happened.
text_cn: 逃生的外方人来到里息雅那里，向他报告一切经过。

text_en: When he heard it, he was perplexed and discouraged, for things had not happened to Israel as he had intended, nor had they turned out as the king had ordered.
text_cn: 他一听说这事，张惶失措，因为在以色列竟发生这事，大出他意料之外，与国王所嘱托的大不相同。

text_en: But the next year he mustered sixty thousand picked infantry and five thousand cavalry to subdue them.
text_cn: 次年，他调集六万精兵，五千骑兵，来攻打犹太人。

text_en: They came into Idumea and encamped at Beth-zur, and Judas met them with ten thousand men.
text_cn: 大军来到依杜默雅，在贝特族尔扎了营。犹大带领一万人迎战；

text_en: When he saw that their army was strong, he prayed, saying, “Blessed are you, O Savior of Israel, who crushed the attack of the mighty warrior by the hand of your servant David, and gave the camp of the Philistines into the hands of Jonathan son of Saul, and of the man who carried his armor.
text_cn: 他一见敌军强大，便祈祷说：“以色列的救主，你是可赞美的！从前你藉着你仆人达味的手，粉碎了巨人强力的袭击，你曾把外方人的军营，交在撒乌耳之子约纳堂，和他执戟者的手中；

text_en: Hem in this army by the hand of your people Israel, and let them be ashamed of their troops and their cavalry.
text_cn: 请你将这支军队，困在你百姓以色列的手中罢！使他们的兵马都蒙受羞辱。

text_en: Fill them with cowardice; melt the boldness of their strength; let them tremble in their destruction.
text_cn: 请你使他们恐怖，消散他们逞强的勇气，使他们因溃败而颤栗。

text_en: Strike them down with the sword of those who love you, and let all who know your name praise you with hymns. ”
text_cn: 请你使他们丧身在爱你之人的刀下，使那些认识你名的人，用诗歌来赞颂你。”

text_en: Then both sides attacked, and there fell of the army of Lysias five thousand men; they fell in action.
text_cn: 随后双方交锋，里息雅的军队，约有五千人为犹太人所杀。

text_en: When Lysias saw the rout of his troops and observed the boldness that inspired those of Judas, and how ready they were either to live or to die nobly, he withdrew to Antioch and enlisted mercenaries in order to invade Judea again with an even larger army.
text_cn: 里息雅见自己的阵容已乱，而犹大的士气正盛，且已准备作殊死战；他一见如此便退回安提约基雅，招募客军，加强阵容，预备再攻犹太地。

text_en: Then Judas and his brothers said, “See, our enemies are crushed; let us go up to cleanse the sanctuary and dedicate it. ”
text_cn: 犹大和他的兄弟们说：“看，我们的敌人业已粉碎，我们要上去清洁圣所，再行祝圣礼。”

text_en: So all the army assembled and went up to Mount Zion.
text_cn: 于是全体军队集合，齐上熙雍山。

text_en: There they saw the sanctuary desolate, the altar profaned, and the gates burned. In the courts they saw bushes sprung up as in a thicket, or as on one of the mountains. They saw also the chambers of the priests in ruins.
text_cn: 当他们看见圣所荒芜，祭坛被玷污，门户被焚毁，庭院生满小树，像在树林或山上生长的一般，厢房都已倒塌，

text_en: Then they tore their clothes and mourned with great lamentation; they sprinkled themselves with ashes
text_cn: 便撕裂了衣服，大声哀哭，头上撒灰，

text_en: and fell face down on the ground. And when the signal was given with the trumpets, they cried out to Heaven.
text_cn: 俯首在地；号角一响，他们便向天哀号。

text_en: Then Judas detailed men to fight against those in the citadel until he had cleansed the sanctuary.
text_cn: 那时犹大派人去攻打那些住在堡垒里的人，直到圣所清洁了为止。

text_en: He chose blameless priests devoted to the law,
text_cn: 然后又选定了圣洁和热爱法律的司祭；

text_en: and they cleansed the sanctuary and removed the defiled stones to an unclean place.
text_cn: 这些司祭便清洁圣殿，将被玷污的石头，抛到污秽的地方。

text_en: They deliberated what to do about the altar of burnt offering, which had been profaned.
text_cn: 他们商议，该怎样处理被玷污的全燔祭坛；

text_en: And they thought it best to tear it down, so that it would not be a lasting shame to them that the Gentiles had defiled it. So they tore down the altar,
text_cn: 终于想出了一个好主意，就是将祭坛毁坏，免得常存着为异民玷污的耻辱。于是就将祭坛拆毁了，

text_en: and stored the stones in a convenient place on the temple hill until a prophet should come to tell what to do with them.
text_cn: 将那些石头安放在圣殿山上一个适当的地方，直到一位先知来到，再另行安排。

text_en: Then they took unhewn stones, as the law directs, and built a new altar like the former one.
text_cn: 他们按法律用整块石头，照原先的样式，另修了一座新祭坛。

text_en: They also rebuilt the sanctuary and the interior of the temple, and consecrated the courts.
text_cn: 将圣所及圣殿内部都修饰好，也祝圣了庭院，

text_en: They made new holy vessels, and brought the lampstand, the altar of incense, and the table into the temple.
text_cn: 又制造了新的圣器，将灯台、香坛、供桌，搬进圣殿。

text_en: Then they offered incense on the altar and lit the lamps on the lampstand, and these gave light in the temple.
text_cn: 在香坛上献香，又点着了灯台上的灯，在殿里放光。

text_en: They placed the bread on the table and hung up the curtains. Thus they finished all the work they had undertaken.
text_cn: 在供桌上放上饼，将帐幔挂起来；他们应作的一切工作，于是完成。

text_en: Early in the morning on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month, which is the month of Chislev, in the one hundred forty-eighth year,
text_cn: 一四八年九月，即“基色娄”月， 二十五日清晨，他们起来，

text_en: they rose and offered sacrifice, as the law directs, on the new altar of burnt offering that they had built.
text_cn: 按照法律，在新建的全燔祭坛上献祭。

text_en: At the very season and on the very day that the Gentiles had profaned it, it was dedicated with songs and harps and lutes and cymbals.
text_cn: 即在异民玷污祭坛的同月同日，于唱歌、弹琴、鼓瑟和鸣钹（bó）中，祝圣了祭坛。

text_en: All the people fell on their faces and worshiped and blessed Heaven, who had prospered them.
text_cn: 全体百姓都俯首至地，钦崇赞美那使他们成功的上天。

text_en: So they celebrated the dedication of the altar for eight days, and joyfully offered burnt offerings; they offered a sacrifice of well-being and a thanksgiving offering.
text_cn: 八日之久，举行祭坛的祝圣典礼，都欢乐地献了全燔祭、和平祭及感恩祭。

text_en: They decorated the front of the temple with golden crowns and small shields; they restored the gates and the chambers for the priests, and fitted them with doors.
text_cn: 他们又用金冠铜牌，装饰圣殿正面，又重修大门和厢房，安上门户。

text_en: There was very great joy among the people, and the disgrace brought by the Gentiles was removed.
text_cn: 民众皆大喜欢，因为异民所加于他们的耻辱，现在全除去了。

text_en: Then Judas and his brothers and all the assembly of Israel determined that every year at that season the days of dedication of the altar should be observed with joy and gladness for eight days, beginning with the twenty-fifth day of the month of Chislev.
text_cn: 犹大和他的兄弟们，以及以色列全会众，规定年年在这节期，庆祝重新祝圣祭坛节，即由“基色娄”月二十五日起，一连八天欢乐庆祝，

text_en: At that time they fortified Mount Zion with high walls and strong towers all around, to keep the Gentiles from coming and trampling them down as they had done before.
text_cn: 那时他们也重修熙雍山，在周围建起高墙和巩固的碉楼，免得异民再来，像从前一样蹂（róu）躏（lìn）。

text_en: Judas stationed a garrison there to guard it; he also fortified Beth-zur to guard it, so that the people might have a stronghold that faced Idumea.
text_cn: 犹大又派军队在那里护守；并在贝特族尔设防，使人民对依杜默雅有所保障。
